P-06.title: A Harvest With a Future
hints: Confirm pod maturity before changing irrigation.
Keep Tara watered; dry Alo, then protect twelve planted and thirty reserve.
Six wells of seven give 42; plant 12, seal 30 as 15 plus 15.
P-06.mastery: Mature pods, five-day selective dry-down to moisture 20, six-by-seven count and 12/30 founder split.

first_time_card.title: A harvest with a future
first_time_card.purpose: Preserve a living descendant line and its founder reserve.
steps: Separate old seedling evidence from Alo mature pods.
Stop Alo-only irrigation and wait for the five-day dry-down.
Count six wells, plant twelve and seal thirty with lineage intact.
first_time_card.clip: Selective dry-down and founder-seed count (explainer clip pending)

EX-CH03-S07.title: Young Leaves, Old Map
EX-CH03-S07.goal: Classify the cold annex seedlings and scan the vault map without disturbing them.
EX-CH03-S07.why: Curled day-12 seedlings are not flowers or mature pods.

clues.text: The cold annex image is a day-12 seedling-stage record.
The N.R. map is an archive lead, not a route clearance.

EX-CH03-S07.aha: Classify the cold annex seedlings and scan the vault map without disturbing them.
EX-CH03-S07.wrong_idea: Call curled seedlings failed flowers and handle the archive material.
flight_rules: FR-06 ? Preserve living material and distinguish observation from inference.

EX-CH03-S08.title: A Map Is a Preparation List
EX-CH03-S08.goal: Keep map provenance and list present-day route checks.
EX-CH03-S08.why: An old location can guide a survey, but departure still needs slope, reserve and communications.

clues.text: The map predates the retreat and points to the N.R. archive.
The map is evidence for a route; a verified return plan is still required.

EX-CH03-S08.aha: Keep map provenance and list present-day route checks.
EX-CH03-S08.wrong_idea: Treat the map as permission to depart.
flight_rules: FR-05 ? Verify slope, return reserve and link before any future field route.

EX-CH03-S09.title: Alo Is Mature
EX-CH03-S09.goal: Confirm mature brown pods before stopping Alo-only irrigation.
EX-CH03-S09.why: Mature pods need a controlled five-day dry-down; Tara keeps her own water.

clues.text: Day-35 pods are plump and brown; the flower photograph belongs to the earlier stage.
This is maturity, not the old cold alarm.

EX-CH03-S09.aha: Confirm mature brown pods before stopping Alo-only irrigation.
EX-CH03-S09.wrong_idea: Stop both Alo and Tara irrigation before checking maturity.
flight_rules: FR-06 ? Confirm maturity and isolate Alo irrigation only.

EX-CH03-S10.title: Five Days and Forty-Two Seeds
EX-CH03-S10.goal: Reach moisture 20 or lower, count six wells of seven and choose a 12/30 split.
EX-CH03-S10.why: The 42-seed parent line must supply both descendants and a sealed founder reserve.

clues.text: Alo moisture falls from 70 to 20 over five days while Tara irrigation stays on.
Six pod wells each contain seven seeds: 42 in total.

EX-CH03-S10.aha: Reach moisture 20 or lower, count six wells of seven and choose a 12/30 split.
EX-CH03-S10.wrong_idea: Open damp pods early or spend all 42 seeds on planting.
flight_rules: FR-06 ? Dry mature pods to 20 or lower; protect founder reserve.

risk.title: Wet seed storage or lost founder reserve

EX-CH03-S11.title: Two Places for a Lineage
EX-CH03-S11.goal: Plant 12 positions, seal 30 founder seeds and preserve the parent-line label.
EX-CH03-S11.why: The sealed reserve is 15 plus 15; the planting tray carries twelve.

clues.text: Parent line reads Alo times Tara before any dedication.
Thirty founder seeds are sealed as two compartments of fifteen.

EX-CH03-S11.aha: Plant 12 positions, seal 30 founder seeds and preserve the parent-line label.
EX-CH03-S11.wrong_idea: Rename or plant reserve seeds before the parent line is recorded.
flight_rules: FR-06 ? Keep 12 planted and 30 sealed with the original lineage.

EX-CH03-S12.title: The October Hand-off
EX-CH03-S12.goal: Reconcile the living descendants with the founder reserve and survey preparation.
EX-CH03-S12.why: Alo continues in descendants and preserved seed, not as the same living plant.

clues.text: Twelve descendants grow; the 30 founder seeds remain sealed.
The map has a preparation list, not a departure stamp.

EX-CH03-S12.aha: Reconcile the living descendants with the founder reserve and survey preparation.
EX-CH03-S12.wrong_idea: Present the old map as a completed route permission.
flight_rules: FR-06 ? Keep the living lineage and reserve distinct in the handover.
